import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()

    # Ensure proper types (keep timestamps naive, no timezone conversion)
    events["user_id"] = events["user_id"].astype("int64")
    events["channel"] = events["channel"].astype("str")
    events["event_id"] = events["event_id"].astype("int64")
    events["event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(events["event_ts"])

    # Sort by (user_id, channel, event_ts, event_id) to establish order within each stream
    events = events.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "channel", "event_ts", "event_id"],
        kind="mergesort",
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    if len(events) == 0:
        channel_sessions = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=[
                "user_id",
                "channel",
                "session_num",
                "session_start",
                "session_end",
                "event_count",
            ]
        )
        channel_sessions["user_id"] = channel_sessions["user_id"].astype("int64")
        channel_sessions["channel"] = channel_sessions["channel"].astype("str")
        channel_sessions["session_num"] = channel_sessions["session_num"].astype("int64")
        channel_sessions["session_start"] = pd.to_datetime(channel_sessions["session_start"])
        channel_sessions["session_end"] = pd.to_datetime(channel_sessions["session_end"])
        channel_sessions["event_count"] = channel_sessions["event_count"].astype("int64")
        return {"channel_sessions": channel_sessions}

    # Identify group boundaries (new user_id/channel pair)
    grp_key = list(zip(events["user_id"], events["channel"]))
    grp_change = pd.Series(grp_key).ne(pd.Series(grp_key).shift(1)).fillna(True).values

    # Compute time gap from previous event within the same group
    prev_ts = events["event_ts"].shift(1)
    gap = events["event_ts"] - prev_ts

    gap_threshold = pd.Timedelta(minutes=25)

    # New session if: start of a new (user_id, channel) group OR gap strictly greater than threshold
    new_session = grp_change | (gap > gap_threshold)

    # Session number within each (user_id, channel) group via cumulative sum
    session_id_global = new_session.cumsum()

    events["_session_id"] = session_id_global

    # Aggregate per session
    agg = events.groupby("_session_id", sort=False).agg(
        user_id=("user_id", "first"),
        channel=("channel", "first"),
        session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
        session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
        event_count=("event_id", "count"),
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Compute session_num per (user_id, channel) as 1-based sequential order
    agg = agg.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "channel", "session_start"], kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)
    agg["session_num"] = agg.groupby(["user_id", "channel"], sort=False).cumcount() + 1

    channel_sessions = agg[
        ["user_id", "channel", "session_num", "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]
    ].copy()

    channel_sessions["user_id"] = channel_sessions["user_id"].astype("int64")
    channel_sessions["channel"] = channel_sessions["channel"].astype("str")
    channel_sessions["session_num"] = channel_sessions["session_num"].astype("int64")
    channel_sessions["session_start"] = pd.to_datetime(channel_sessions["session_start"])
    channel_sessions["session_end"] = pd.to_datetime(channel_sessions["session_end"])
    channel_sessions["event_count"] = channel_sessions["event_count"].astype("int64")

    channel_sessions = channel_sessions.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "channel", "session_num"], kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"channel_sessions": channel_sessions}
